selection_process: Selection for these posts follows a multi-stage process combining a physical efficiency test, a written exam, and (for driver posts) a trade test. || Application scrutiny:Only candidates meeting all eligibility conditions are permitted to the physical efficiency test stage. || Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - completed:Conducted by the department for the 7 non-Station-Officer posts, out of 100 marks; General category candidates required a minimum of 50 marks, SC/ST/OBC candidates a minimum of 40 marks.
